description_en: Retrieves the details of a file
description_zh: 该接口用于获取文件的详情
name: GetFile

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace name.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。

该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html API to query the ID of the corresponding file
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduling node. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html API to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 调度节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

AdvancedSettings.description_en:
Advanced configuration of the job.

This parameter corresponds to "Advanced Settings" in the right-side navigation bar on the editing page of an EMR Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

Currently, EMR Shell jobs do not support advanced parameters.

For details about advanced parameters for different EMR job types, see [EMR Job Development]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473077.html）
AdvancedSettings.description_zh:
任务的高级配置。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，EMR数据开发任务，编辑页面右侧导航栏的“高级设置“对应。

当前EMR Shell任务不支持配置高级参数。

各EMR任务开发的高级参数说明，请参见[EMR任务开发]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473077.html）

AutoParsing.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic parsing is enabled for the file. Valid values:

true: The code in the file is automatically parsed.

false: The code in the file is not automatically parsed.

This parameter corresponds to the "Code Parsing" option in the DataWorks console (https\://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) when you select "Same Cycle" under Schedule Configuration > Schedule Dependency for a Data Development job
AutoParsing.description_zh:
文件是否开启自动解析功能。取值如下：
true：文件会自动解析代码。
false：文件不会自动解析代码。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖”选择“同周期”时的“代码解析”对应

BizId.description_en: The ID of the Business Process to which the file belongs. This field is deprecated. Use the BusinessId field instead
BizId.description_zh: 文件所属业务流程的ID。该字段已废弃，请使用BusinessId字段

BusinessId.description_en: The Business Process ID of the file

CommitStatus.description_en:
The current commit status of the file. Valid values:

0: The latest code has not been submitted.

1: The latest code has been submitted
CommitStatus.description_zh: 文件当前的提交状态，包括0（未提交最新的代码）和1（已提交最新的代码）

ConnectionName.description_en: The name of the data source used when executing the job corresponding to the file
ConnectionName.description_zh: 执行文件对应的任务时，所使用的数据源名称

CreateTime.description_en: UNIX timestamp when the file was created, in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件创建的时间戳，单位为毫秒

CreateUser.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud User ID of the file creator
CreateUser.description_zh: 文件创建人的阿里云用户ID

CurrentVersion.description_en: Version number of the latest submitted version of the file
CurrentVersion.description_zh: 文件当前已经提交的最新版本号

DeletedStatus.description_en:
The deletion status of the file. Valid values:

NORMAL: Not deleted.

RECYCLE_BIN: In the recycle bin.

DELETED: Deleted
DeletedStatus.description_zh:
文件的删除状态。取值如下：
NORMAL：未删除。
RECYCLE_BIN：回收站。
DELETED：被删除

FileFolderId.description_en: The ID of the folder to which the file belongs

FileType.description_en: The code type of the file. Different file types use different code. For more information, see [DataWorks Edge Zone Collection]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）
FileType.description_zh: 文件的代码类型。文件类型，不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）

IsMaxCompute.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource file needs to be uploaded to MaxCompute.
Configure this parameter only when the file is a MaxCompute resource file
IsMaxCompute.description_zh:
标识该资源文件是否需要上传至MaxCompute。
仅当文件是MaxCompute资源文件时才需要配置该参数

LastEditTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the most recent edit to the file, in milliseconds
LastEditTime.description_zh: 最近一次编辑文件的时间戳，单位为毫秒

LastEditUser.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud User ID of the user who last edited the file
LastEditUser.description_zh: 最近一次编辑文件的阿里云用户ID

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling task generated in the CDN mapping system after the file is submitted
NodeId.description_zh: 提交文件后，在调度系统生成的调度任务ID

Owner.description_en: Alibaba Cloud User ID of the file owner
Owner.description_zh: 文件责任人的阿里云用户ID

ParentId.description_en: If the current file is an internal file of a composite edge zone file, this field identifies the ID of the corresponding composite edge zone file
ParentId.description_zh: 如果当前文件是组合节点文件的内部文件，该字段标识对应组合节点文件的ID

UseType.description_en:
The function module to which the file belongs. Valid values:

NORMAL: Data Development.

MANUAL: One-time task.

MANUAL_BIZ: Manually triggered workflow.

SKIP: Dry-run scheduling in Data Development.

ADHOCQUERY: Ad-hoc query.

COMPONENT: Widget Management
UseType.description_zh:
文件所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL：数据开发。
MANUAL：手动任务。
MANUAL_BIZ：手动业务流程。
SKIP：数据开发的空跑调度。
ADHOCQUERY：临时查询。
COMPONENT：组件管理

NodeConfiguration.description_en: The schedule configuration of the file

ApplyScheduleImmediately.description_en: Whether to apply the schedule configuration immediately after publishing
ApplyScheduleImmediately.description_zh: 是否发布后立即生效调度配置

AutoRerunIntervalMillis.description_en:
The time interval between automatic reruns after an error, in milliseconds. This parameter corresponds to the "Rerun Interval" setting under "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties > Auto Rerun on Error" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).
Note that the time unit for "Rerun Interval" in the console is minutes; convert the time accordingly when invoking the API
AutoRerunIntervalMillis.description_zh:
出错自动重跑时间间隔，单位为毫秒。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>出错自动重跑”的”重跑间隔“配置对应。
控制台中“重跑间隔”的时间单位为分钟，请在调用时注意转换时间

AutoRerunTimes.description_en: The number of automatic reruns after an error

CronExpress.description_en: The Cron Expression for timed scheduling of the file
CronExpress.description_zh: 文件定时调度的cron表达式

CycleType.description_en:
The type of recurrence, including NOT_DAY (minute, hour) and DAY (day, week, month).

This parameter corresponds to "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties > Recurrence" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
CycleType.description_zh:
调度周期的类型，包括NOT_DAY（分钟、小时）和DAY（日、周、月）。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>调度周期”对应

DependentNodeIdList.description_en:
When the DependentType parameter is set to USER_DEFINE, this parameter specifies the IDs of the nodes on which the current file depends. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).

This parameter corresponds to the configuration when, in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), the "Schedule Configuration > Schedule Dependency" of a Data Development job is set to "Previous Cycle" and the dependency option is set to "Other Nodes"
DependentNodeIdList.description_zh:
当DependentType参数配置为USER_DEFINE时，用于设置当前文件具体依赖的节点ID。依赖多个节点时，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖”配置为“上一周期”后，依赖项选择”其他节点“时配置的内容对应

DependentType.description_en:
The method of depending on the previous cycle. Valid values:

SELF: The dependency is the current node itself.

CHILD: The dependency is direct child nodes.

USER_DEFINE: The dependency is other specified nodes.

NONE: No dependency is selected, meaning the node does not depend on the previous cycle
DependentType.description_zh:
依赖上一周期的方式。取值如下：
SELF：依赖项选择本节点。
CHILD：依赖项选择一级子节点。
USER_DEFINE：依赖项选择其他节点。
NONE：未选择依赖项，即不会依赖上一周期

EndEffectDate.description_en:
The UNIX timestamp, in milliseconds, when automatic scheduling stops.

This parameter corresponds to the millisecond UNIX timestamp of the end time configured in the "Scan Configuration > Time Properties > Effective Date" setting for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
EndEffectDate.description_zh:
停止自动调度的时间戳，单位为毫秒。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>生效日期”配置的结束时间的毫秒时间戳对应

IgnoreParentSkipRunningProperty.description_en: Schedule Configuration > Previous Cycle > Whether to ignore the upstream dry-run property
IgnoreParentSkipRunningProperty.description_zh: 调度配置->上一周期->是否跳过上游的空跑属性

InputList.description_en: Information about outputs from upstream files on which this file depends
InputList.description_zh: 依赖的上游文件输出信息

items.description_en: Information about outputs from upstream files on which this file depends
items.description_zh: 依赖的上游文件输出信息

Input.description_en:
The output name of the upstream file on which this file depends.

This parameter corresponds to "Parent Node Output Name" when "Same Cycle" is selected under "Schedule Configuration > Schedule Dependency" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Input.description_zh:
文件依赖的上游文件的输出名称。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖“选择”同周期“时的”父节点输出名称”对应

ParseType.description_en:
The method for configuring file dependencies. Valid values:

MANUAL: Manually configured.

AUTO: Automatically parsed
ParseType.description_zh:
配置文件依赖的方式，取值如下：
MANUAL：手动配置。
AUTO：自动解析

ParameterName.description_en:
The parameter name of the input parameter in the node context. You can reference this parameter in code by using the ${...} syntax.

This parameter corresponds to the "Parameter Name" field under "Schedule Configuration > Node Context > Input Parameters of This Node" in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
ParameterName.description_zh:
节点上下文输入参数的参数名称。在代码中可以使用${...}方式引用该参数。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>节点上下文>本节点输入参数“的”参数名“对应

ValueSource.description_en:
The value source of the input parameter in the node context.

This parameter corresponds to the "Value Source" field under "Schedule Configuration > Node Context > Input Parameters of This Node" in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
ValueSource.description_zh:
节点上下文输入参数的取值来源。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>节点上下文>本节点输入参数“的”取值来源“对应

Output.description_en:
Output name of the file.

This parameter corresponds to the value in the "Output Name" column when "Same Cycle" is selected under "Scan Configuration > Schedule Dependency" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Output.description_zh:
文件的输出名称。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖“选择”同周期“时的“本节点的输出名称”列值对应

RefTableName.description_en:
Output value of the file.

This parameter corresponds to the value in the "Output Table" column when "Same Cycle" is selected under "Scan Configuration > Schedule Dependency" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
RefTableName.description_zh:
文件的输出值。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖“选择”同周期“时的“本节点的输出表”列的值对应

Description.description_en: The description of the output parameter in the edge zone context
Description.description_zh: 节点上下文输出的参数描述

ParameterName.description_en:
The parameter name of the output parameter in the node context.

This parameter corresponds to the "Parameter Name" field under "Schedule Configuration > Node Context > Output Parameters of This Node" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
ParameterName.description_zh:
节点上下文输出参数的参数名称。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>节点上下文>本节点输出参数“的”参数名“对应

Type.description_en:
The type of the expression for the edge zone context output parameter. Valid values are as follows:

1: constant

2: variable

3: pass-through variable from a parameter node

This parameter corresponds to the "Type" field in the "Scan Configuration > Edge Zone Context > Output Parameters of This Node" section for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Type.description_zh:
节点上下文输出参数表达式的类型。取值如下：
1：表示常量。
2：表示变量。
3：表示参数节点透传变量。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>节点上下文>本节点输出参数“的”类型“对应

Value.description_en:
The expression of the output parameter in the edge zone context.

This parameter corresponds to the "Value" field in the "Scan Configuration > Edge Zone Context > Output Parameters of This Node" section for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Value.description_zh:
节点上下文输出参数的表达式。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>节点上下文>本节点输出参数“的”取值“对应

ParaValue.description_en:
Schedule parameter.

This parameter corresponds to the "Scan Configuration > Parameters" setting for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). You can refer to the [Schedule Parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137548.html） documentation for configuration details
ParaValue.description_zh:
调度参数。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>参数”对应。您可以参考[调度参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137548.html）配置

RerunMode.description_en:
Rerun property. Valid values:

ALL_ALLOWED: The job can be rerun regardless of whether it previously Succeeded or failed.

FAILURE_ALLOWED: The job cannot be rerun if it previously Succeeded, but can be rerun if it previously failed.

ALL_DENIED: The job cannot be rerun regardless of whether it previously Succeeded or failed.

This parameter corresponds to the "Scan Configuration > Time Properties > Rerun Property" setting for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
RerunMode.description_zh:
重跑属性。取值如下：
ALL_ALLOWED：运行成功或失败后皆可重跑。
FAILURE_ALLOWED：运行成功后不可重跑，运行失败后可以重跑。
ALL_DENIED：运行成功或失败皆不可重跑。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>重跑属性”配置内容对应

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group used when the file is published as a Job and executed. You can call [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html） to obtain the list of available resource groups in the workspace
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 文件发布成任务后，任务执行时对应的资源组。您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html）获取工作空间可用的资源组列表

SchedulerType.description_en:
The schedule type. Valid values:

NORMAL: Normal scheduling task.

MANUAL: One-time task, which is not included in regular scheduling and corresponds to a node in a manually triggered workflow.

PAUSE: Paused task.

SKIP: Dry-run task, which is included in regular scheduling but is immediately marked as Succeeded when scheduled
SchedulerType.description_zh:
调度的类型，取值如下：
NORMAL：正常调度任务。
MANUAL：手动任务，不会被日常调度，对应手动业务流程下的节点。
PAUSE：暂停任务。
SKIP：空跑任务，被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功

StartEffectDate.description_en:
The UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) indicating when automatic scheduling starts.

This parameter corresponds to the start time (as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds) configured under "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties > Effective Date" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
StartEffectDate.description_zh:
开始自动调度的毫秒时间戳。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>生效日期”配置的开始时间的毫秒时间戳对应

StartImmediately.description_en:
Indicates whether to start immediately after publishing.

This parameter corresponds to the "Start Method" setting under "Configuration > Time Properties" in the right-side navigation bar on the editing page for EMR Spark Streaming and EMR Streaming SQL Data Development jobs in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
StartImmediately.description_zh:
发布后是否立即启动。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，EMR Spark Streaming和EMR Streaming SQL数据开发任务，编辑页面右侧导航栏的“配置>时间属性>启动方式“对应

Stop.description_en:
Indicates whether to skip execution. Valid values:

true: Skip execution.

false: Do not skip execution.

This parameter corresponds to the setting "Schedule Type" under "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties" for a Data Development job in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), when it is set to "skip execution"
Stop.description_zh:
是否暂停调度，取值如下：
true：暂停调度。
false：不暂停调度。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>调度类型”配置为”暂停调度“时对应

RequestId.description_en: Request ID. Used for troubleshooting when a fault occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the invocation succeeded. Valid values:

true: The invocation succeeded.

false: Failed to invoke
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
